I love my Keurig 2.0 machine but the pods can be a bit pricey. These cups allow me to use my favorite coffee and save money.
1. Easy to use, easy to clean
2. Secure open and close
3. Fine mesh sides, perfect for brewing
4. Fits well, no technical problems
I definitely would recommend these pods to any one.
The K-Carafe pod is difficult to fit into my K-200. If it isn't lined up just right, the Keurig tells me that the pod isn't compatible. The two smaller ones work fine.
These do a good job for the price. I wish the lid latched a little better, some pop open in storage, but overall are good.

I ordered this for my KEURIG coffee maker.
I needed it badly.
I was excited when it arrived.
It didn't fit my coffee maker.. Such a sad thing.
When my daughter received the package 3 of the pod filters was broken!
Great price
Careful... This is NOT a Kenmore filter. Its a replacement. Zoom into see the small red print.
Just put it in couple days ago. Good so far.
Perfect and economical replacement. No leaks
I want to find replace the original
works great and exceptional value
Great price and quick delivery.
arrived quickly. Great product.
This filter works well. It has a good strong, fast flow unlike previous brand filters I have purchased for my GE refrigerator. Nice clear-looking and tasting water.

Followed the directions and soaked the filter in water for 15 minutes to remove air from it. Unlike the GE equivalent, these instructions make no mention of needing to run several gallons of water. In the particular refrigerator this is installed into, the total volume of water in line from the filter, through the cooling coils to the water dispenser is a little over a 1.5 liters. So, I filled to 32 ounce glasses, dumped them and tried the water. The taste is excellent, that is, no taste other than water. That's what I am after. Job well done!
Very good washer

This machine is great!  I get happy every time I wash because I'm saving $$$  It's a little time consuming to do laundry as 1) The hose that comes with it must fit the sink in a doll house...it's way too small for any faucet I have so I fill the machine using a water picture.  2) I have to put it in the bathtub to drain properly.  3) The washer load amount VS the spinner load amount is quite different so it might take you four spin cycles to a wash load.  4) It's awesome because it really does spin the clothes to almost completely dry but be careful how you place the items in the basket or it will be off-centered and will not spin well.  4) Use a very small amount of detergent.  I like that I can let really soiled items soak for awhile and wash as long as needed to get items clean.  I would recommend this to anyone who doesn't have washer/dry hookups and has a small space.  This machine is perfect.
Nice replacement product.
Water is very clear and tastes good, too.
nice try but don't bother - too hard to get grounds to proper fineness - best left to commercial suppliers of pods
Not a producer of clean, good tasting water, can still taste the chlorine. Not as good as the original!
Fast shipment and good quality. Thanks.
Great product!

I wished I read some of the other reviews more carefully, this ice maker worked great for 7 months that is (bought October, 2017). As I read the other reviews now, it seems the ice maker's life is about 6-8 months before it will stop working. Checked for leakage, replace with colder water and do a full reset (turn off let it rest), sadly did not work. I sent a email to request the warranty and customer service number, will update later.

Makes ice very fast. Ice seems to last longer in your drinks if you put the cubes in the refrigerator and then use them. Make sure to make a couple of batches before using the ice otherwise they will taste bad.

Used this for the first time while camping over the weekend. Made ice immediately and never stopped. Set to medium sized cubes and they were perfect for beverages. Very pleased with this purchase and with customer service. Unit arrived missing a peg leg. One email to company and I received a pack of 4 in the mail within days. Also purchased extended warranty.  Very happy with this purchase.
Both work great!!!!!!

Very satisfied with my purchase of the replacement charcoal filters for my Keurig. They fit perfectly and happy I don't have to soak them in water first. Others filters had the water black with charcoal residual and never felt quite right using them at all. The coffee taste is just fine and I will continue to purchase from this vendor in the future!

The replacement charcoal filters were dimensionally correct, and were easy to install in my appliance.  The filter seems to perform well;  there is no discernable difference in the taste of my coffee.  Price was significantly less than brand name product.
Already reviewed on company's site but excellent reusable set ! Love them !! No more waste on disposable pods and helps keep a green environment.
Works great!

Ok, these reusable K-Cup filters are not something that will last long enough to hand down to the kids. But they do the job.
I got the large one to be able to make large cups of coffee, or full the carafe. It does that perfectly
The top is hinged and has a rubber gasket. The small one was included and I consider it a bonus.
I have had NO grounds in the coffee using these; only the regular bit of sludge.
(If you don't have sludge in your cup, it's not strong enough!!! Not just with these, but however it's made!)
The pricing is very good.
When I wear these out, I hope they will still be available. I like them

I read all the listings for a little washing machine before choosing this one. What sold me was it's the largest capacity one out there. When I first got it, I thought it was too big. Now I'm ok with it because you don't have to fill it all the way, you adjust the water level manually to the level you want and wash as few or as many pcs of laundry as you want. The pump expels water very well, which was a concern of mine. My laundry has never gotten cleaner! And I can get all the soap out so no residue! The spin side does an amazing job, better than a full size washer. I think it's only 300 watts to run it! For all the upside, there are a few Cons: I have to use my handheld shower to fill it, the water inlet hoses are useless. My husband made a little wood frame with wheels for it so I can move it into the bathroom to use it. I have to tape the expel hose to the bathtub so it doesn't jump out. The wash cycle timer knob doesn't line up with the times printed around it. Cord is a bit short, but it does have 2 clips to secure it to the back of the washer which is good, and the expel hose has a place on the side to hook onto too.
I was shocked at how powerful this is, both wash cycle and spin. Some water will splash out so be mindful of that when you plug it in. The water hits the lid and runs down and when open, splashes. Over all, it's been a real life saver though. I dare you to take any clean laundry you have and run it through this with just water and just see w
Pump stopped working after 3 uses and the lid on the washer side arrived with a broken hinge.  There are many other options on the market.  Don't think I would recommend Della brand.  :-(

I just got my Della and used it for the first time.  I did a small load - 5 tops, a pair of light athletic pants, and 3 intimates.  It problem would have held a few more items but, I was just trying it out.  It worked great.  I am very particular about my wash and have no qualms about how it washed.  All my clothes were black and I will wash like colors and materials in the future.  I am sure a large load will hold a lot of clothes.  The spinner is awesome.  I used it for 3 minutes and clothes came out super dry.  The machine did have an odor.  When I first opened the box, it smelled like smoke, and now I think it has a sort of oil smell.  My clothes don't smell, and I put a bowl of ammonia in each side and maybe that will help to take the smell out.  I'm hoping after a few uses it dissipates.  Like others, the cord is short and the discharge hose too.  I will be trying a couple of different solutions to get a better set-up.  I use a low suds soap and used about a tablespoon.  I'm sold so far.  I did take out insurance and have read some less than stellar reviews from people who had problems.  I hope I don't experience what they went through.  For someone who despised the laundromat,  this is great.  I live in a small country cottage after selling my home.  The creepiness of having to wash my clothes with Lord knows what goes into the machines makes this a must.  Delivered on time.  Seller seems to want happy customers.
